extraction_notes: The supplied three-page datasheet identifies the RS3MF variant in the RS3AF through RS3MF family table and gives revision Rev:1.0; pages 1 through 3 were examined.

Fig. 3 is a usable typical forward-voltage curve at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. Points are direct observations from the supplied plot; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 is a usable typical reverse-characteristics plot with separate Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC curves. Reverse-current values are represented as positive magnitudes because the plotted axis is instantaneous reverse current in uA; points are direct observations from the supplied plot.

The RS3MF electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF = 1.3 V at IF = 3.0 A, maximum Trr = 500 ns at IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, and Irr = 0.25 A, maximum IR1 = 5.0 uA at VR = VDC and Ta = 25 degC, maximum IR2 = 500 uA at VR = VDC and Ta = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 48 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.

Absolute maximum ratings for RS3MF are VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A, and IFSM = 70 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave; junction and storage temperature ratings are -55 to +150 degC. These ratings are limits, not fitted curve points.
The supplied datasheet publishes no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC ratings are not substituted for breakdown data.
